description: Client-side derived-counter encode + parse vectors. A derived counter is a server-defined expression over other counters; the SDK read surface is just GET /v1/derived/{key}/value and /series. There is no happy-path http vector (a definition is created only on the dashboard/JWT plane the http runners cannot reach — see ../http/README.md), so correctness of encoding+parsing is pinned here. `encodeQuery` maps derived-series read params to the query string (presence-exact, same rule as series/cases.json — every key listed present, every key not listed absent). `parse` maps a response body to typed fields; `kind` selects the schema. The derived surface is DECIMAL, not integer: `DecimalValue` is a signed arbitrary-precision decimal STRING that is `null` when the expression divided by zero — SDKs MUST surface null (with the `reason`) rather than throw, and MUST NOT parse the string to a native float (precision loss). Loader contract in README.md.

encodeQuery.name: derived-series-params
encodeQuery.note: GET /v1/derived/{key}/series takes ONLY from/to/bucket/tz. There is deliberately no gapfill, no mode, and no member on this surface: those keys MUST NOT appear in the query. Presence-exact already forbids them (they are not listed); `absent` restates it for loader authors.

encodeQuery.name: derived-series-minimal
encodeQuery.note: tz optional and omitted -> exactly from/to/bucket.

parse.name: derived-value
parse.note: DerivedValueResponse: `value` is a scale-6 decimal string, `scale` its fixed decimal places, `inputs` a map of each referenced counter's current integer-string value. `value` stays a STRING (arbitrary precision; parsing 0.052337 to a float is banned). No `reason` when value is non-null.

parse.name: derived-value-null-division-by-zero
parse.note: The headline null case: the expression divided by zero, so `value` is JSON null and `reason` explains it. An SDK MUST surface value=null plus the reason (a typed nullable / optional), NOT throw and NOT coerce null to "0". The inputs that produced it are still present (here the denominator counter reads "0").

parse.name: derived-series-null-mid-point
parse.note: DerivedSeriesResponse: per-bucket decimal points where a bucket that divided by zero has `v: null` (a hole in the middle of the series, not the end). SDKs preserve the null point in place; the surrounding points stay decimal strings. Point wire keys are t/v as in a plain series.
